newsitem.title: TURKEY: Iranian oil minister to visit Turkey.
newsitem.headline: Iranian oil minister to visit Turkey.

text.p: Iranian Oil Minister Gholamreza Aghazadeh is to arrive in Turkey this week to discuss energy projects between the two countries, a statement from the Turkish energy ministry said on Sunday.

Aghazadeh will hold talks with Turkish Energy Minister Recai Kutan, President Suleyman Demirel and Islamist Prime Minister Necmettin Erbakan on Tuesday after which a joint protocol is expected to be signed, the statement said.

Turkey signed a $23-billion deal for Iranian natural gas during a visit to Tehran by Erbakan in August as part of his drive to forge closer relationships with other Moslem countries. The gas deal was condemned by the United States.
Turkey is expected to face energy shortages as demand, currently rising at 12 percent a year, peaks later in the year.
